def hidden_rule_fn(state):
    n = len(state)
    result = [[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            ne = state[(i-1)%n][(j+1)%n]
            nw = state[(i-1)%n][(j-1)%n]
            se = state[(i+1)%n][(j+1)%n]
            sw = state[(i+1)%n][(j-1)%n]
            cur = state[i][j]
            d_z = sum(1 for v in [ne, nw, se, sw] if v == 0)
            d_p = sum(1 for v in [ne, nw, se, sw] if v == 1)
            d_q = sum(1 for v in [ne, nw, se, sw] if v == 2)
            # Rule: next = (cur + 2) mod 3 if (d_p == 0 and cur == 2) or (d_q == 0 and cur == 2 and d_p == 1) or (d_q == 3 and cur == 0)
            # Otherwise next = cur
            if (d_p == 0 and cur == 2) or (d_q == 0 and cur == 2 and d_p == 1) or (d_q == 3 and cur == 0):
                result[i][j] = (cur + 2) % 3
            else:
                result[i][j] = cur
    return result
